stadia.name: MetLife Stadium
stadia.description: One of the largest stadiums in the USA, MetLife Stadium will host the World Cup final. Located just outside New York City, it offers easy access to one of the world's greatest tourist destinations.

stadia.name: SoFi Stadium
stadia.description: A state-of-the-art stadium in Los Angeles County. SoFi Stadium features a stunning architectural design and is surrounded by the entertainment capital of the world.

stadia.name: AT&T Stadium
stadia.description: Home of the Dallas Cowboys, this massive domed stadium in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex offers a world-class sporting experience with its iconic video board.

stadia.name: Mercedes-Benz Stadium
stadia.description: An architectural marvel in downtown Atlanta with a retractable roof shaped like a camera aperture. The stadium is known for its innovative design and fan experience.

stadia.name: NRG Stadium
stadia.description: A domed stadium in Houston's NRG Park complex. Known for hosting major sporting events and its retractable roof technology.

stadia.name: Levi's Stadium
stadia.description: Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, Levi's Stadium offers a modern experience near San Francisco and the tech capital of the world.

stadia.name: Gillette Stadium
stadia.description: Home of the New England Patriots, located just outside Boston. A modern stadium with excellent facilities and easy access to historic Boston.

stadia.name: Lincoln Financial Field
stadia.description: An iconic stadium in Philadelphia, known for its passionate sports culture and location in the historic South Philadelphia Sports Complex.

stadia.name: BC Place
stadia.description: A stunning domed stadium in downtown Vancouver, surrounded by mountains and ocean. Vancouver offers incredible natural beauty and outdoor activities.

stadia.name: BMO Field
stadia.description: Canada's premier soccer-specific stadium located on the Toronto waterfront. Toronto is a multicultural hub with world-class dining and entertainment.

stadia.name: Estadio Azteca
stadia.description: One of the most iconic stadiums in world football history. Estadio Azteca has hosted two World Cup finals and is steeped in footballing heritage.

stadia.name: Estadio BBVA
stadia.description: A modern architectural masterpiece set against the backdrop of the Cerro de la Silla mountain. Monterrey offers a unique blend of industry and nature.

stadia.name: Estadio Akron
stadia.description: Home of Club Deportivo Guadalajara (Chivas), this modern stadium is located in Mexico's second-largest city, known for tequila, mariachi, and rich culture.

stadia.name: Estadio Universitario
stadia.description: Home of UANL Tigres, this passionate stadium in Monterrey offers an authentic Mexican football atmosphere.

stadia.name: Estadio Guadalajara
stadia.description: Also known as Estadio Jalisco, this historic stadium has hosted multiple World Cups and is a symbol of Mexican football heritage.

stadia.name: Hard Rock Stadium
stadia.description: Located in the vibrant Miami area, this stadium offers access to beautiful beaches, Latin culture, and world-class nightlife.

hotels.name: The Manhattan Luxury Hotel
hotels.description: A five-star luxury hotel in the heart of Manhattan with stunning skyline views, world-class dining, and a rooftop pool.

hotels.name: Hollywood Hills Resort
hotels.description: A glamorous resort nestled in the Hollywood Hills with panoramic views of Los Angeles and the Hollywood sign.

hotels.name: Dallas Downtown Inn
hotels.description: A comfortable mid-range hotel in downtown Dallas with easy access to AT&T Stadium and local attractions.

hotels.name: Atlanta Peach Boutique Hotel
hotels.description: A charming boutique hotel in downtown Atlanta, steps from the Mercedes-Benz Stadium and the Georgia Aquarium.

hotels.name: Houston Space City Hotel
hotels.description: A family-friendly hotel near NRG Stadium with space-themed rooms and a complimentary shuttle to the stadium.

hotels.name: Silicon Valley Tech Hotel
hotels.description: A modern tech-themed hotel in Silicon Valley with high-speed WiFi, smart rooms, and a shuttle to Levi's Stadium.

hotels.name: Boston Harbor Hotel
hotels.description: An elegant waterfront hotel in Boston with stunning harbor views, award-winning dining, and easy access to Gillette Stadium.

hotels.name: Philadelphia Liberty Hotel
hotels.description: A historic hotel in downtown Philadelphia near the Liberty Bell and Lincoln Financial Field.

hotels.name: Vancouver Mountain View Hotel
hotels.description: A beautiful hotel with mountain and ocean views in downtown Vancouver, close to BC Place and Stanley Park.

hotels.name: Toronto Harbourfront Hotel
hotels.description: A waterfront hotel on Lake Ontario with stunning city views, near BMO Field and the CN Tower.

hotels.name: Mexico City Grand Hotel
hotels.description: A grand colonial-style hotel in the historic center of Mexico City, near the Zocalo and Estadio Azteca.

hotels.name: Monterrey Mountain Resort
hotels.description: A resort hotel with stunning mountain views in Monterrey, close to both Estadio BBVA and Estadio Universitario.

hotels.name: Guadalajara Hacienda Hotel
hotels.description: A charming hacienda-style hotel in Guadalajara with traditional Mexican architecture and modern amenities.

hotels.name: Miami Beach Resort & Spa
hotels.description: A luxurious beachfront resort on Miami Beach with world-class spa, multiple pools, and access to South Beach nightlife.

restaurants.name: Times Square Bistro
restaurants.description: A vibrant bistro in the heart of Times Square offering classic American cuisine with a modern twist.

restaurants.name: Hollywood Star Restaurant
restaurants.description: A celebrity-favorite restaurant serving farm-to-table Californian cuisine with views of the Hollywood Hills.

restaurants.name: Texas Smokehouse BBQ
restaurants.description: Authentic Texas BBQ with slow-smoked brisket, ribs, and all the classic Southern sides.

restaurants.name: Atlanta Soul Food Kitchen
restaurants.description: Traditional Southern soul food with fried chicken, collard greens, and cornbread in a cozy setting.

restaurants.name: Houston Tex-Mex Cantina
restaurants.description: Vibrant Tex-Mex restaurant serving sizzling fajitas, enchiladas, and margaritas near NRG Stadium.

restaurants.name: San Francisco Seafood Grill
restaurants.description: Fresh Pacific seafood with stunning views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Fisherman's Wharf.

restaurants.name: Boston Clam Chowder House
restaurants.description: New England's finest seafood restaurant serving clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fresh Atlantic fish.

restaurants.name: Philly Cheesesteak House
restaurants.description: The ultimate Philly cheesesteak experience with authentic Amoroso rolls and perfectly grilled steak.

restaurants.name: Vancouver Pacific Rim Restaurant
restaurants.description: Award-winning Pacific Rim cuisine featuring fresh local ingredients and stunning waterfront views.

restaurants.name: Toronto Maple Leaf Bistro
restaurants.description: Modern Canadian cuisine with maple-infused dishes, poutine, and locally sourced ingredients.

restaurants.name: Mexico City Taqueria
restaurants.description: Authentic street-style tacos with fresh tortillas, al pastor, and traditional Mexican salsas.

restaurants.name: Monterrey Grill & Cantina
restaurants.description: Northern Mexican cuisine featuring cabrito (roasted goat), carne asada, and handmade tortillas.

restaurants.name: Guadalajara Tequila & Tacos
restaurants.description: Traditional Jalisco cuisine with birria, tortas ahogadas, and an extensive tequila selection.

restaurants.name: Miami Cuban Cafe
restaurants.description: Authentic Cuban cuisine with ropa vieja, Cuban sandwiches, and fresh mojitos in the heart of Little Havana.

attractions.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
attractions.description: Iconic American symbol and UNESCO World Heritage site. Take a ferry from Battery Park to visit Liberty Island and Ellis Island.

attractions.name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
attractions.description: Stroll along Hollywood Boulevard and find your favorite celebrity's star on this world-famous sidewalk.

attractions.name: The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza
attractions.description: A museum chronicling the life, death, and legacy of President John F. Kennedy, located in the former Texas School Book Depository.

attractions.name: Georgia Aquarium
attractions.description: One of the largest aquariums in the world, home to whale sharks, beluga whales, and thousands of marine species.

attractions.name: Space Center Houston
attractions.description: The official visitor center for NASA's Johnson Space Center, featuring space artifacts, interactive exhibits, and tram tours.

attractions.name: Golden Gate Bridge
attractions.description: One of the most photographed bridges in the world, spanning the Golden Gate strait with stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco Bay.

attractions.name: Freedom Trail
attractions.description: A 2.5-mile red-brick walking trail through downtown Boston that leads to 16 historically significant sites from the American Revolution.

attractions.name: Liberty Bell & Independence Hall
attractions.description: Iconic symbols of American independence where the Declaration of Independence and Constitution were debated and adopted.

attractions.name: Stanley Park
attractions.description: A magnificent urban park surrounded by the waters of Vancouver Harbour and English Bay, featuring ancient forests, trails, and stunning views.

attractions.name: CN Tower
attractions.description: Canada's iconic 553-meter communications and observation tower with a glass floor and revolving restaurant offering panoramic city views.

attractions.name: Chapultepec Castle
attractions.description: A historic castle atop Chapultepec Hill housing the National Museum of History, with stunning murals and panoramic views of Mexico City.

attractions.name: Cerro de la Silla
attractions.description: The iconic saddle-shaped mountain that is the symbol of Monterrey, offering hiking trails and breathtaking views of the city.

attractions.name: Hospicio Cabañas
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring stunning murals by Jose Clemente Orozco, including the famous 'Man of Fire' in the chapel dome.

attractions.name: South Beach & Art Deco District
attractions.description: World-famous beach with crystal-clear waters, pastel-colored Art Deco architecture, vibrant nightlife, and celebrity-watching opportunities.
